title: The Club Flag
sentences: Bill and Ty had a plan for a club flag.
Ty had a stick and a black rag.
Bill set the stick on it.
Bill said, "I can clip the rag to the stick."
He did, and the rag did not slip.
The black rag was a flag.
Ty had a grip on the stick.
He put it up and gave it a swish.

comprehensionQuestion.question: What kept the rag from slipping off the stick?
